# Website

A static website: the page is `site/index.html`, its styles are in `site/css/`, its scripts in `site/js/` and its images in `site/assets/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved screenshots; the differences are saved as images in `test-results/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no" />

// Serves site/ on http://127.0.0.1:4173 (or $PORT). No dependencies.
const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const root = path.join(__dirname, 'site');
const port = Number(process.env.PORT || 4173);

const types = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
  '.png': 'image/png',
  '.jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.ico': 'image/x-icon',
  '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
  '.woff': 'font/woff',
  '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
};

function resolve(urlPath) {
  const rel = path.posix.normalize('/' + decodeURIComponent(urlPath.split('?')[0]));
  let file = path.join(root, rel);
  if (!file.startsWith(root)) return null;
  if (fs.existsSync(file) && fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()) file = path.join(file, 'index.html');
  return fs.existsSync(file) ? file : null;
}

http
  .createServer((req, res) => {
    let file = null;
    try {
      file = resolve(req.url);
    } catch {
      file = null;
    }
    if (!file) {
      res.writeHead(404, { 'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Not found');
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'content-type': types[path.extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream',
      'cache-control': 'no-store',
    });
    fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
  })
  .listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => {
    console.log(`Serving site/ on http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  });

content.text:
I haven't fixed it. I couldn't find a cause in the site's code, so I haven't changed any files.

- **What the test shows:** `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` fails at both desktop and phone size. About 1% of pixels differ. The page height matches the approved screenshot (6140px) and the layout and images are unchanged. Nearly all the difference is in text, spread across the nav, headings, paragraphs, team names and footer.
- **Services section:** In the approved screenshot, the three service paragraphs wrap about 40px narrower than they do now. For example, "dicta impedit." now breaks differently. I couldn't tell what made them narrower.
- **Rest of the text:** Widths are off by about 1px, and not in a consistent direction. Nav items are 1–3px wider or narrower than before, depending on the word.
- **What I tried:** I injected CSS overrides and measured the pixel difference against the approved image.
  - Font families, weights and sizes made no improvement.
  - Letter-spacing, kerning, ligatures, text-rendering and optical sizing made no improvement.
  - Padding and gutters on the services columns made no improvement.
  - Chromium font-hinting flags made no improvement.
- **What the approved screenshot uses:** It uses the Inter font, which is installed here. Roboto Slab and Montserrat, the two fonts the CSS asks for, aren't installed here.
- **Possible clue:** `index.html` has the "Google fonts" and "Font Awesome" comments with no `<link>` tags under them. Those tags can't load offline, so I don't think they explain it. The service icons are also missing from the current render.
- **Why I couldn't go further:** The repo has a single commit, so there's no earlier version to diff against. I also can't tell whether the approved screenshots came from a different rendering setup.

To take this further, I'd need the previous version of the page (or the commit that changed it), or confirmation of how and where the approved screenshots were generated. If you know which section changed, I can start there.

I left a local server running in the background from my experiments.

STATUS: NOT DONE
